finalists.label: Lingual Thyroid
finalists.why: It has the most specific and decisive findings for it, including a non-homogeneous mass-like prominence at the base of the tongue and several adjacent nodular structures enhanced similarly to thyroid tissue.

finalists.label: Lymphoma
finalists.why: It is proposed as a possible cause for the non-homogeneous, contrast-enhancing area at the tongue base, but lacks specific evidence compared to other candidates.

finalists.label: Thyroid Dysgenesis
finalists.why: It is supported by the absence of the thyroid gland in its normal location, but does not directly explain the mass-like prominence at the base of the tongue.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it specifically accounts for the mass-like prominence at the base of the tongue and the absence of the thyroid gland in its normal location, with the most direct and relevant evidence.
